## The Ten Ministries

Every citizen is assigned **one ministry and one quest**. *You do not have to choose. That kindness has already been arranged.*

{{< include _ministries.qmd >}}

---

## The soft voice (crew guidance)

Ministries never punish. They *help*. When you staff a ministry:

* Speak gently, smile, and assume the citizen agrees with you. They will, eventually.
* Never threaten. Everything has *already been decided*, for their own good.
* Praise compliance lavishly. Be a little disappointed by everything else.
* Every request is heard. Every request is *decided*.
* Guests can always step out of the game. **"OZONE"** pauses roleplay immediately.
